paragraphs.text: Shirei (SHEE-ray) is a kami from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Shirei is the kami of the disgraced and abandoned battlefield called Shizo . It acts as a kind of shepherd of the dead. Its haunting appearance is that of a floating white-robed and hooded apparition with black dry skin, too many bulbous green eyes and tiny sharp teeth. A wooden grave marker is strapped to its back with numerous red ropes, and several lit cemetery braziers circle its head.
